title: The normal heart in five views

items.question: Which is the correct order of the five screening planes, from caudal to cranial?
options: Situs, four-chamber, LVOT, RVOT / three-vessel, three-vessel-and-trachea
Four-chamber, situs, RVOT, LVOT, three-vessel-and-trachea
Situs, LVOT, four-chamber, three-vessel-and-trachea, RVOT
Four-chamber, LVOT, RVOT, situs, three-vessel
items.explanation: The sweep runs from the upper abdomen up through the heart to the upper mediastinum.

items.question: What is the normal cardiac axis?
options: About 45 degrees to the left, within 20 degrees either way
About 20 degrees to the left, within 10 degrees either way
About 90 degrees to the left
Midline
items.explanation: The long axis of the heart points left at about 45 degrees; 20 degrees either side is the 2 SD range.

items.question: How much of the chest does a normal heart occupy?
options: About one third of the thoracic area
About one tenth
About two thirds
Nearly all of it
items.explanation: Roughly a third of the thoracic area.

items.question: A fetal heart rate stays at 100 beats per minute throughout the scan. What should happen?
options: Prompt review by a fetal cardiac specialist
Nothing; this is within the normal range
Repeat the anomaly scan at 32 weeks
Record it as a normal variant
items.explanation: Normal is 120 to 160. A rate fixed below 110 needs timely specialist evaluation for possible heart block.

items.question: You can see four chambers. Is that a normal four-chamber view?
options: Not yet: the view has specific criteria beyond the count
Yes: four chambers means the view is normal
Yes, provided the heart rate is normal
Only colour Doppler can tell
items.explanation: The four-chamber and three-vessel views are assessed against criteria, not counted.

items.question: In normal situs, where does the inferior vena cava lie in the upper-abdomen plane?
options: In front of and to the right of the spine
Behind the spine
To the left of the spine, behind the aorta
Inside the liver on the left
items.explanation: Stomach left; aorta left of the spine; IVC anterior and right.

items.question: What must be established before assessing situs?
options: Which side is the fetal left and right
The cardiac axis
The heart rate
The size of the great arteries
items.explanation: Laterality first. Without it, 'stomach on the left' means nothing.

items.question: When is mid-trimester cardiac screening best performed?
options: 18 to 22 weeks
11 to 14 weeks
24 to 28 weeks
After 32 weeks
items.explanation: 18 to 22 weeks is the recommended window.
